name: Family Fishing and Camping
skip_reason: Fails the live-web-presence rule, and the only firsthand length figure is under 23 ft. The official domain familyfishingncamping.com is PARKED - it returns a 114-byte stub that JS-redirects to /lander - so there is no operator site; there is no bookable listing anywhere (a 2024 review reports they stopped taking reservations); the Facebook page's newest visible posts are from 2019; and the newest firsthand review of any kind is 2024-05-18, which only says tent sites are gone. Campendium's single dated report (2022-06-09) gives max RV length 20.0 ft, below EKKO's 23 ft, and describes 'full time campers' present with 'no amenity's (bath house, laundry) no picnic tables or fire pits on sites'. NOT confirmed closed - 82 grass-pad sites and a 2024 sighting suggest something still operates at 790 Family Drive - but with a parked domain, no booking channel and a sub-23-ft report it cannot be added on the available evidence. Worth one phone call to 304-265-1000 if it is ever revisited.
